title: bupleurum subovatum f. genuinum
intro: Bupleurum subovatum f. genuinum, commonly known as Chinese Thunder of Heaven, is a plant species within the Bupleurum genus and has been widely used in traditional Chinese medicine for its medicinal properties. It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, depression, and stress due to its adaptogenic properties. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum subovatum f. genuinum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-modulating effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used to treat liver and kidney disorders.
